name: 3-Pyridinemethanol
description: 3-Pyridinemethanol (CAS 100-55-0 ), also known as nicotinyl alcohol, is a pyridine-based primary alcohol used across pharmaceutical synthesis, flavoring, and specialty chemical manufacturing. It functions primarily as a reactive intermediate and surface-active agent, enabling downstream production of more complex molecules and formulations in various industrial sectors. In pharmaceutical manufacturing, it serves as a key building block for synthesizing active ingredients and drug candidates, particularly where a pyridine-containing alcohol moiety is required. Food and flavor formulators incorporate it as a flavoring agent, where its characteristic profile contributes to specific taste compositions in approved applications for the food industry. In polymer and resin systems, it acts as a surface modifier and wetting agent, improving adhesion and substrate compatibility in coatings and plastic formulations for industrial use. Personal care chemists also evaluate it as a stabilizing component in preservation systems where biocidal or antioxidant activity is needed alongside formulation compatibility and stability. The material is supplied as a liquid at standard commercial purities, typically ranging from 98% to 99%+ for synthesis-grade material to ensure high performance in chemical reactions. Pharmaceutical-grade material is available to meet the purity and quality documentation requirements of API and intermediate manufacturing for global regulatory compliance.
